scientific_purpose: Preregistered 5-arm x 3-LR same-seed early publisher-language learning rate tuning on authentic frozen FIT; select each optimizer's LR strictly using two previously exposed but within-study tuning-DEV owners, never the other two report-DEV owners. Prepares further five-seed study; no architecture superiority or blind generalization claimed.

real_world_source.name: Original licensed PSF CPython 3.13.0 14-document FIT publisher corpus and source-registered UTF8 supplement

causal_protocol: Exact original hash-pinned LANGMEM086 active 100521p model freshly initialized with seed1701 for each of fifteen arms/trials; exactly first 32 actual publisher FIT schedule batches B4 context256, identical in order with original LANGMEM086 FIT_PLAN. No past nor future target fed to model; input raw[:-1], label raw[1:]. Optimizer mode and LR are the only randomized trial differences, AdamW fallback group fixed lr0.001 for TAO arms while only FFN-up 15040 weights use the orthogonal trial LR; baseline AdamW all weights trial LR. All other optimizer hyperparams fixed from TAO003. Three LR trials per optimizer, no retries/cherry-picked nonfinite results. Fit-to-Git original checkpoints BEFORE opening development data. Source owner-traversal fixed; first256 actual next-byte labels of each of existing exposed original CPython DEV docs controlflow.rst,index.rst solely for tuning. Freeze selected LR per mode by min NLL, deterministic lower-LR tie break. introduction.rst,venv.rst not opened by this tuning scorer, reserved for within-study reporting after separate 5-seed fits. All documents historically exposed in TAO003 and are NOT new blind test.
checkpoint_policy: Write 15 original full model+optimizer+Py/NumPy/Torch RNG checkpoints and source/fit-byte order+model+trial receipts under research/evidence/taotune004/seed1701/<mode>/lr<index> on isolated Git branch, preserve every failed trial. Commit full frozen set into Git before a separate clean-checkout tuning scorer can access 2 fixed previously exposed tune-DEV docs. No original weights replaced. Numerically bounded cross-host logits require exact model/optimizer hashes, source and top-1; preserve bitwise failure independently. Final actual-size/checkpoint gate.

budget.experiment_cost: free standard GitHub Actions CPU only

treatment.other_weights: AdamW lr0.001 except whole-model AdamW baseline

evaluation.tuning_selection: min observed tune-DEV NLL, deterministic lower LR tie break

limitations: Same training model data and exposures but optimizer-specific update FLOPs differ and are reported, not falsely declared equal. One-seed three-LR prospective selection only; do not use previous TAO003 results to change registered grid, not a global or independently qualified winner.
